# Network profiles: validation (with the EAP-TLS certificate and key checks), the two-slot NVS store over a fake,
# the card inbox, the USB protocol and the join order. The certificate checks run on a host Mbed TLS 3.6.6, the
# version ESP-IDF 5.5 builds into the reader, configured like the reader (no MBEDTLS_HAVE_TIME_DATE). Point
# MBEDTLS_SOURCE and MBEDTLS_BUILD at a built tree, as test/message_tls does, or the release is fetched and built here.
# Synthetic keys and certificates are generated by the tests themselves; none is committed.
if(EXISTS "${MBEDTLS_SOURCE}/include/mbedtls/x509_crt.h" AND EXISTS "${MBEDTLS_BUILD}/library/libmbedx509.a")
  add_library(network_profile_mbedtls INTERFACE)
  target_include_directories(network_profile_mbedtls INTERFACE "${MBEDTLS_SOURCE}/include")
  target_link_libraries(network_profile_mbedtls INTERFACE "${MBEDTLS_BUILD}/library/libmbedtls.a"
    "${MBEDTLS_BUILD}/library/libmbedx509.a" "${MBEDTLS_BUILD}/library/libmbedcrypto.a")
else()
  FetchContent_Declare(
    mbedtls
    URL https://github.com/Mbed-TLS/mbedtls/releases/download/mbedtls-3.6.6/mbedtls-3.6.6.tar.bz2
    URL_HASH SHA256=8fb65fae8dcae5840f793c0a334860a411f884cc537ea290ce1c52bb64ca007a
  )
  set(ENABLE_PROGRAMS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(ENABLE_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(MBEDTLS_FATAL_WARNINGS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(USE_SHARED_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(USE_STATIC_MBEDTLS_LIBRARY ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
  set(MBEDTLS_USER_CONFIG_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/reader_mbedtls_config.h" CACHE FILEPATH "" FORCE)
  FetchContent_MakeAvailable(mbedtls)
  add_library(network_profile_mbedtls INTERFACE)
  target_link_libraries(network_profile_mbedtls INTERFACE mbedtls mbedx509 mbedcrypto)
endif()

add_executable(NetworkProfileTest
  NetworkProfileTest.cpp
  NetworkStoreTest.cpp
  NetProvisionTest.cpp
  NetworkJoinTest.cpp
  TestPki.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/CertificateDates.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetCodec.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetJson.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkProfile.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkProfileStore.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkCardImport.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetProvisionProtocol.cpp
  ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkJoin.cpp
)

target_include_directories(NetworkProfileTest PRIVATE ${REPO_ROOT}/src ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network ${REPO_ROOT}/src/ambient)

target_link_libraries(NetworkProfileTest PRIVATE
  crosspoint_test_common
  network_profile_mbedtls
  GTest::gtest_main
)

gtest_discover_tests(NetworkProfileTest DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT 60)

# The glue tests: the reader's own join code (NetworkJoinDevice, NetworkProfileDevice, MethodNetDevice,
# ConnectionCheckNetwork) compiled unchanged against a fake Wi-Fi radio, supplicant, NVS, card and clock (glue/). The
# pure-logic tests above cover decisions; these cover that the real device classes wire the decisions up. They parse
# JSON with the ArduinoJson sources the x4pro build fetches, as test/method_check does.
set(GLUE_ARDUINOJSON_DIR "${REPO_ROOT}/.pio/libdeps/x4pro/ArduinoJson/src")
if(EXISTS "${GLUE_ARDUINOJSON_DIR}/ArduinoJson.h")
  # The English strings, generated into the build directory from the yaml (scripts/gen_i18n.py), for the text the Network
  # screens build.
  find_package(Python3 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Interpreter)
  set(GLUE_I18N_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/glue_i18n")
  file(GLOB GLUE_TRANSLATIONS "${REPO_ROOT}/lib/I18n/translations/*.yaml")
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${GLUE_I18N_DIR}/I18nKeys.h" "${GLUE_I18N_DIR}/I18nStrings.h" "${GLUE_I18N_DIR}/I18nStrings.cpp"
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "${GLUE_I18N_DIR}"
    COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/gen_i18n.py" "${REPO_ROOT}/lib/I18n/translations" "${GLUE_I18N_DIR}/"
    DEPENDS ${GLUE_TRANSLATIONS} "${REPO_ROOT}/scripts/gen_i18n.py"
    COMMENT "Generating the English strings for the glue tests"
    VERBATIM)
  add_executable(NetworkGlueTest
    glue/GlueTest.cpp
    glue/GlueStubs.cpp
    glue/I18nGlue.cpp
    "${GLUE_I18N_DIR}/I18nStrings.cpp"
    TestPki.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/lib/PlaqueBoard/PlaqueBoard.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/activities/ambient/MethodNetDevice.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/activities/settings/ConnectionCheckNetwork.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/CertificateDates.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/ClockProvenance.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/ClockProvenanceDevice.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/MessageTls.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetCodec.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetJson.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkCardImport.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkJoin.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkJoinDevice.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkProfile.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkProfileDevice.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network/NetworkProfileStore.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/lib/TrustedTime/TimeServers.cpp
    ${REPO_ROOT}/lib/TrustedTime/TrustedTime.cpp
  )
  # lib/TrustedTime is compiled for real; its time() and settimeofday() are the fake system clock's.
  set_source_files_properties(${REPO_ROOT}/lib/TrustedTime/TrustedTime.cpp PROPERTIES
    COMPILE_OPTIONS "-include;glue_time_shim.h")
  # The stubs come first: <Arduino.h>, <WiFi.h>, <HalStorage.h>, "WifiCredentialStore.h" and the rest are the fakes.
  target_include_directories(NetworkGlueTest BEFORE PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/glue/stubs
    ${GLUE_I18N_DIR}
  )
  target_include_directories(NetworkGlueTest PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/network
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/ambient
    ${REPO_ROOT}/src/activities/settings
    ${REPO_ROOT}/lib/Memory
    ${REPO_ROOT}/lib/TrustedTime
    ${REPO_ROOT}/lib/PlaqueBoard
    ${GLUE_ARDUINOJSON_DIR}
  )
  target_link_libraries(NetworkGlueTest PRIVATE
    crosspoint_test_common
    network_profile_mbedtls
    GTest::gtest_main
  )
  gtest_discover_tests(NetworkGlueTest DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT 60)
endif()
